{
  "findings": [
    {
      "page": 196,
      "where": "Formula (2), explanatory description of A_{n+1}",
      "scan": "ensemble des éléments de A_n",
      "tex": "ensemble des éléments de $A_n$.",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "ensemble des éléments des éléments de $A_n$.",
      "note": "The print omits the second « des éléments »: the union consists of elements of elements of A_n. The TeX keeps this misprint."
    },
    {
      "page": 196,
      "where": "End of the final sentence",
      "scan": "tout segment de I distinct de I a un cardinal < c.",
      "tex": "\\emph{tout segment de $I$ distinct de $I$ a un cardinal",
      "kind": "marker",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "note": "Page 196 includes the final inequality and full stop. Its ending `$<\\sheaf{\\sheaf{c}}$.}` is instead at the beginning of the supplied p.197 cut, without a neighbouring-page allowance. Page 197 begins « Nous noterons ». Recut only; no content edit."
    },
    {
      "page": 197,
      "where": "Introduction of the least element of I; repeated notation on pp.197–199",
      "scan": "Nous noterons $\\varepsilon$ le plus petit élément de $I$.",
      "tex": "noterons $\\mathcal{E}$ le",
      "kind": "symbol",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "noterons $\\mathcal{E}$ le",
        "new": "noterons $\\varepsilon$ le"
      },
      "note": "The print uses a lower-case epsilon, not a calligraphic capital E. Reported once for this uniform substitution: extend the replacement to every occurrence on pp.197–199."
    },
    {
      "page": 197,
      "where": "Paragraph beginning « On a d'abord »",
      "scan": "$A=A_0$",
      "tex": "$A=A_{\\circ}$",
      "kind": "symbol",
      "confidence": "medium",
      "fix": {
        "old": "$A=A_{\\circ}$",
        "new": "$A=A_0$"
      },
      "note": "The round printed subscript is the zero index of the sequence defined in (2), not a circle symbol."
    },
    {
      "page": 197,
      "where": "End of the proof of (4)",
      "scan": "Ceci démontre (4).",
      "tex": "Ceci démontre",
      "kind": "marker",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "note": "The concluding `(4).` is printed on p.197 but starts the supplied p.198 cut. Page 198 begins « Montrons maintenant qu'on a ». Recut only; no content edit."
    },
    {
      "page": 198,
      "where": "Proof of (5), immediately after the reference to A_n",
      "scan": "$X\\subset A_{n+1}$",
      "tex": "$X\\subset A_{n+1}$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "$x\\subset A_{n+1}$",
      "note": "The capital X is a misprint for the lower-case x used throughout this argument. The TeX keeps it."
    },
    {
      "page": 198,
      "where": "(U.I), first sentence stating the required conclusion",
      "scan": "Il s'agit de montrer qu'on $y\\in U$.",
      "tex": "qu'on a $y\\in U$.",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "qu'on a $y\\in U$.",
      "note": "The print omits « a » after « qu'on ». The TeX silently corrects this omission."
    },
    {
      "page": 199,
      "where": "(U.IV), cardinality of the interval following the displayed union",
      "scan": "$\\card([\\varepsilon,\\alpha(\\lambda)])<\\sheaf{\\sheaf{c}}$",
      "tex": "$\\card([\\mathcal{E},\\alpha(\\lambda)]<\\sheaf{\\sheaf{c}}$",
      "kind": "formula",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "\\alpha(\\lambda)]<",
        "new": "\\alpha(\\lambda)])<"
      },
      "note": "The TeX omits the closing parenthesis of card, which is present after the interval's closing bracket in the print."
    },
    {
      "page": 199,
      "where": "(U.IV), « On a donc », before the reference to (U.I)",
      "scan": "$x_{\\lambda}\\subset B_{\\beta}$",
      "tex": "$x_{\\lambda}\\in B_{\\beta}$ d'après",
      "kind": "symbol",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "$x_{\\lambda}\\in B_{\\beta}$ d'après",
        "new": "$x_{\\lambda}\\subset B_{\\beta}$ d'après"
      },
      "note": "The print states inclusion here, not membership. The preceding membership statement is correctly transcribed."
    },
    {
      "page": 200,
      "where": "Definition 4, « On dit »",
      "scan": "On dit qu'un ensemble x est",
      "tex": "On dit qu'on ensemble $x$ est",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "qu'on ensemble",
        "new": "qu'un ensemble"
      },
      "note": "The print reads « qu'un », not « qu'on »."
    },
    {
      "page": 200,
      "where": "Definition 4, condition on the components",
      "scan": "si tous les composants de x ont",
      "tex": "si tout les composants de $x$ ont",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "tout les composants",
        "new": "tous les composants"
      },
      "note": "The print reads « tous », not « tout »."
    }
  ],
  "coordinator": "Counts (normal/misprint, including markers under normal): 196: 1/1; 197: 3/0; 198: 0/2; 199: 2/0; 200: 2/0.\nRecut 196/197: the initial `$<\\sheaf{\\sheaf{c}}$.}` of the p.197 cut completes p.196; p.197 starts « Nous noterons ».\nRecut 197/198: the initial `(4).` of the p.198 cut completes p.197; p.198 starts « Montrons maintenant qu'on a ».\nUniform notation correction throughout pp.197–199: extend \\mathcal{E} → \\varepsilon to all occurrences; three examples are p.197 « Nous noterons », p.198 α=ε in the proof of (5), and p.199 the interval [ε,α(λ)]."
}
